description: TY2025: the fixture-54 homeowner itemizer, now with the AMT computed rather than ignored — SALT addback of 25,000 puts AMTI at 172,000, far under the exemption phase-out; TMT (26% x 35,000 = 9,100 on the post-exemption base) is well below the 22,168 regular tax -> AMT $0 and the net is UNCHANGED. Pins that implementing AMT did not disturb ordinary returns.
